# Removing nsIMsgSend crypto members preserves the separate compose-security call

The 2616 and 2623 interface cleanups remove nsIMsgSend.BeginCryptoEncapsulation and cryptoclosure. The different nsIMsgComposeSecure interface still declares beginCryptoEncapsulation with output stream, recipients, compose fields, headers, identity, report and draft flag. Current MimeMessage calls that method on _composeSecure. These are different receivers and contracts; the send-interface removals are not removal of encryption. No cryptographic result, execution or full security review is claimed. Required Bug scope is unavailable and own reviews deferred, so zero full-audit credit.

Scope: Compose-security receiver distinction.
